questions.subject: physics
questions.text: A $1.5 \mathrm{~kg}$ model helicopter has an initial velocity of $5 \hat{\mathrm{j}} \mathrm{ms}^{-1}$ at $\mathrm{t}=0 \mathrm{sec}$. It accelerated at a constant rate for 2 seconds, after which it has a velocity of $(6 \hat{i}+12 \hat{j}) \mathrm{ms}^{-1}$. What is the magnitude of the resultant force acting on the helicopter during this interval?

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: During COVID-19 pandemic, a pickup truck of mass $4 \times 10^{3} \mathrm{~kg}$ and a microbus of mass $10^{3} \mathrm{~kg}$ were delivering oxygen cylinders to a hospital. The velocity of the pickup truck was $80 \mathrm{~km}$ per hour. In order to achicve the same kinetic energy, what should be the velocity of the microbus?

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: $6000 \mathrm{MJ}$ of kinetic energy is transferred to an artificial satellite of $200 \mathrm{~kg}$ mass while it is taken to a particular altitude from the earth's surface. At what altitude will the satellite revolve around the earth? The mass of earth is $6 \times 10^{24} \mathrm{~kg}$, radius is $6400 \mathrm{~km}$ and $\mathrm{G}=6.6 \times 10^{-11} \mathrm{Nm}^{2} \mathrm{~kg}^{-2}$.

The temperature when $\mathrm{A}$ and $\mathrm{B}$ are mixed is $16^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, and when $\mathrm{B}$ and $\mathrm{C}$ are mixed, it is $23^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. What is the temperature of the mixture when $\mathrm{A}$ and $\mathrm{C}$ liquids are mixed?
